name: nft-marketplace-challenge
description: Marketplace de NFTs — desafio frontend com frontend (Vercel) e API (Render).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix api run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix api install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix api run typecheck
